provenance.soil: Illustrative loam from previous project; not measured.
provenance.kcb: FAO56 Table17 olive 40-60% canopy endpoints .55/.65. Monthly allocation .60 in April/November is ASSUMED, not a published monthly calendar. Replace all 12 values with user inputs. No automatic local climate correction.

provenance.runoff: CN=70 assumed constant, daily event approximation, not continuous infiltration.
provenance.eto: Supplied externally; example values generated, not FAO-PM weather estimates.
provenance.management: Mature rainfed orchard, fixed geometry, no active understory; no irrigation, interception, capillary rise, snow or frost.
